scene sky
I had a dream about Futaba last night, and it only mildly involved her breasts.
The two of us were tightrope walkers. And she was worried she would fall.
So I did what any good man would do and helped her be confident in herself even though I also doubted her ability to complete the task at hand.

Ultimately, we both failed. But it wasn’t because neither one of us was good at tightrope walking. It was because the rope turned into a snake halfway through and started lunging at the circus elephants.
Futaba’s breasts cushioned her fall (that’s where the loose connection comes in), but I woke up just as I hit the ground since that just always happens in dreams for some reason.

Now, what does this mean? Hell if I know. But I figured this morning would be a good opportunity to go tell her about it while also reminiscing about the days I used to come here and potentially getting a handjob under the table.
scene futabaliblove1
And if Futaba isn’t into that, that’s okay because Nodoka is pretty much always down for anything so long as I’m sad.
: Whatever you’re thinking, I’m in. I can tell it’s sexual in nature.
: Good morning, Sensei. Please ignore her. She’s lashing out since I’ve already rebuffed her three times today.
: Fewer than I would have thought. You two are hanging out again?
scene futabaliblove2
: That’s right. Nodoka did her best to apologize, so I’m doing my best to...try and forget about her divulging every single intimate detail about my sex life to thousands of readers.
: If it’s any consolation-
: It’s not. There’s no consolation for something like that.
: I was just going to say your scenes were the only ones I’ve pleasured myself to.
: See, this is exactly why you should just stop talking altogether after I interrupt you.
: I’ll read that book one day.
scene futabaliblove3
: Why? You’ve already lived it.
: Yes, but this would give me a chance to re-live all the good parts without all of the trauma that eventually led to them happening.
: At least until the prequel is finished. I haven’t written anything down yet, but you’ll be happy to know I play the events in my head almost constantly.
: No I won’t, Nodoka. I won’t be happy to know that.
scene futabaliblove4
: Once more, I am the only one in the room with any sort of understanding of what it means to have “fun.”
: Do you need something Sensei? Or are you just here to chat like in the old days?
: I had a dream about your breasts.
: Oh. Thank you.
: Or...rather, your breasts were in the dream.
: Is this you trying to say that I was in your dream?
: And some elephants, yeah.
scene futabaliblove5
: I like where this is going.
: I don’t.
: Anyway, yeah. That’s kind of just the excuse I was going to use to come talk to you. But if you’re already hanging out with Nodoka-
: I’ll gladly trade the two of you if it’s an option. Even if I have to hear about what happened with the elephants.
: That’s fine. My creative juices are starting to secrete as we speak. I could use this opportunity to bottle them up and sell them to my fans.
scene futabaliblove6
: Or I could sit down beside you and the three of us could attempt to have a normal conversation without anyone’s fluids being bottled up.
: But what is a library even for if not the hushed and dulcet tones of a grown man professing his desire to claim the nubile flesh of adolescents?
: Reading.
: I’m sorry. I don’t know what that is.
: I’m starting to think I should be the one to leave if anything. I’m not sure how I’m supposed to compete with whatever this flavor of character chemistry is.
scene futabaliblove7
: I like to think of us as father and daughter.
: I don’t.
: You’re free to do the same if you like, Futaba.
: You’re not.
scene futabaliblove8
: Instead, why don’t you tell me about your week instead? We haven’t really had a real talk ever since you called me out in front of everyone on the beach and made Rin cry.
: Oh, Akira. This sudden silent treatment would pain me deeply if I were not such a masochist.
scene futabaliblove9
: My week was fine. I got an A on a paper we needed to write about Akechi Mitsuhide. And my parents sent me some money back from the US, so I blew a little of that on gashapon with Molly.

: What else did I do? I...cleaned the dorm, taught Rika how to screw in a light bulb for a third time, trimmed my bangs, and realized that I’m definitely in love with you and that I’m going to make you say it back to me or probably die trying.
scene futabaliblove10
: What?
: Now, I am clearly no expert when it comes to social cues, but I am pretty sure this is a conversation I should not literally be in the middle of.
: Uhh...what? Could you...repeat that, please?
scene futabaliblove11
: Sure, yeah. I trimmed my bangs.
: R...Right. I knew you wouldn’t just come out and-
scene futabaliblove12
: Also, I am in love with you. Now, say it back for I have earned it and refuse to grow up and work at CompanyCorp.
scene futabaliblove10
: What?
: Again, it really feels like I should not be here right now. Every second I spend between the two of you is one more that I’m tempted to scribe.
: What...happened to that whole thing about never exchanging those words until you’ve figured out how to love yourself? Also, what is CompanyCorp?
scene futabaliblove12

: If you’re exempt from ever loving yourself but still get to go around exchanging those words with people, I think I should be allowed to as well. Unless you’re okay with just never having sex with me again.
: So my options are tell you I love you or never have sex with you again?

: Yes. But I also don’t want you to just say you love me for the sole purpose of being able to sleep with me. I want you to actually love me. No — I command you to love me. We can talk about marriage later.
scene futabaliblove10
: What?
: I’ll likely sound like a broken record here, but-
scene futabaliblove13
: Futaba, should we maybe talk about this when it’s a little less...I don’t know. Spontaneous? Because between this and what happened on the beach-
: Sensei, I don’t even really remember what happened on the beach. But, from what I understand, it sounds like I confronted you about this there too.
: So have you stopped to think that maybe one of the reasons I’m struggling to love myself is that I’m having copious amounts of intercourse with a man who vehemently refuses to say he loves me?
: Because I think that’s a thing that would get to most people. And that whatever your methods are here are probably coming from the right place, but are just wrong and that you should change them.
: That...I...
: I also want an “I love you.”
: Shut up, Nodoka. This is my scene.
scene futabaliblove14
: You don’t say. There’s no conceivable way I’d ever write something like this.
: Does it need to be now? Like...isn’t this a little too...normal? Don’t you want the moment to be a little bigger?
: Nope. Now is fine. But if you need a minute or two to figure out how to say it, I can just go back to doing my homework.
: Fine. I...love you.
scene futabaliblove15
: I don’t believe you. That didn’t sound sincere enough.
: What? I-
: You’re not lying, are you? Because if you’re lying, I’m really never doing it with you again.
: Of course I’m not lying. But it’s important that you don’t interpret this like Chika did and think that just because I feel this way means that I-
scene futabaliblove16
: Oh, yeah. I don’t expect you to drop any of your other hundred relationships or anything like that.

: This is mostly just for my own personal growth so I stop hallucinating scenarios in which older women explain to me that I’m boring and that I’m going to end up as an unsatisfied wage-slave for the rest of my life.
: Sorry, hallucinating? See, I knew something was wrong. Whatever happened on the beach is still affecting you. Have you been sleeping well enough lately? Are you eating?
: Both. Quite regularly too. And while it may be true that there is something wrong with me, I feel great right now. Probably on account of finally hearing how you feel after literal years.
: You don’t look great. You went through this entire exchange without so much as a smile.

: I’ll smile when the “I love you” sounds a little more sincere. For now, we should both take solace in the fact that we can still have sex. And that we will do so in my dorm room later tonight. Understood?
scene futabaliblove17
: I spoke too soon with Uta the other day. I do have trauma now. This is the single most torturous conversation I’ve ever been a part of as I know I won’t be permitted to join.
: Yes, Futaba. I will have sex with you in your dorm later. And you can tell me more about these hallucinations and this apparently older woman who has somehow gotten through to you when-
scene futabaliblove18
scene black
scene futabaliblove19
: What’s up? I know it sounds weird, but I’m being serious.
: Aki-kun, how come they don’t have any of my work here? You don’t think it could be because like 75%% of it involved our totally wholesome and not at all sexy relationship, do you?
: Futaba...this “older woman” you hallucinated...didn’t happen to look like Ami, did she?
scene futabaliblove20
: Wha...how did you know?
: Uh-oh.
: Wait, you saw her too?! Who else has she made contact with?! Just what do I have to do to experience the same?!
: Could the two of you...excuse me for one moment please?
scene futabaliblove21
: Hahah! Would you look at the time? I should probably be going now, huh?
: Wait, “too?” Other people have been seeing her? It’s not just me? Why? Ami doesn’t know, does she? Because I figured she would have said something if-
scene futabaliblove22
: Oh.
: He’s gone.
scene futabaliblove23
: Not so fast, you predatory poltergeist.
scene futabaliblove24
: H...Heeeeeey! You wouldn’t reeeeeeeally be mad at me, right? I taught you what an orgasm feels like!
: Sekai...what are you doing? Why is Futaba hallucinating you and why did it immediately change her?
scene futabaliblove25
: Forgive me, Aki-kun! I know I’m probably overstepping here, but it’s for a good reason! I swear!
: And that reason is?
scene futabaliblove26
: I struck a deal with Satan where I get to come back to life once you impregnate your entire class.
: Why don’t you look like you believe me?
: Because I don’t. And I want to know what you’re really doing and who else you’ve done this to. Because Tsuneyo saw you too. And she’s suddenly different now as well.
: That makes sense. Getting strapped to a cross and forcibly fingered will do that to a girl.
: You did what? Tsuneyo was telling the truth about that?!
scene futabaliblove27
: Well somebody had to awaken the sexy side of her! And lord knows you weren’t about to do that any time soon! It’s the same reason I woke that Uta girl up and I didn’t even get to finger that one!
: How? Why? What are you after and what the fuck can I do to get you to just leave me and everyone else alone?
: Stop fucking stalling, that’s what! This has been going on long enough, hasn’t it?! If you actually want to complete the collection, I can help! I know what these girls need better than you do!
: Yeah. Just like you knew what I needed better than I did, right?
scene futabaliblove28
: No, Aki-kun.
: I was the one who needed you back then. Don’t mix that up.
: Just...leave them alone. Haunt me if you have to, but if I find out you’re meddling in anyone else’s mind, I’m drowning the world in holy water and erasing you once and for all.
scene futabaliblove29
: Imagine if that actually worked? That’d be so anticlimactic.
: Why are you even upset, though? I have a success rate of 100%% so far. Tsuneyo wants your cock, Uta’s no longer freaking out, and Futaba finally got what she’s been chasing from the start.
: Because it’s not real! You’re making them feel that way!
scene futabaliblove30
: You have no idea what I’m doing! It’s not like you can see what happens when I haunt them, as you put it! I’m not forcing anyone to do anything! I can’t make people feel things!
: Oh, so Tsuneyo asked you to strap her to a cross and forcibly finger her?
scene futabaliblove31
: That...well...
scene futabaliblove32
: Oh, wow. Maybe I really am the bad guy?
: Sensei?
scene futabaliblove33
: She came a bunch of times, though! So that’s a win for me as far as I’m concerned!
: Sekai...
: Bye-bye, Aki-kun! I’ll try to be a little more careful with my dreamweaving from now on!
scene futabaliblove34
: Hey...is everything okay?
: I’m sorry if I overwhelmed you back there. I know you don’t really like confrontation, but...I’ve wanted to say all of that stuff for a really long time and just-
: It’s nothing you did, Futaba. I’m...proud. That you were finally able to say all of that.
: Sensei, you...
: You and Ami’s mom-
scene futabaliblove35
: With all due respect, that’s not really something I want to get into with you, Futaba.

: That’s fine...I won’t force you to do anything. Except having sex with me later. Because I might not be smiling on the outside, but my insides are literally on fire after hearing you finally say you love me.
: Well...I’m glad.
: Could you...say it again, though? Without Nodoka around this time?
scene futabaliblove36
: It’s nothing against her, it’s just...Well, when you picture something in your head for so long, you kind of get an idea of how it’s going to go down and...
: And I can’t imagine today was anything even close to what you imagined.
: Not remotely. But...it could be at least...mildly closer if it’s just the two of us?
: Right outside of the library is a...pretty fitting place for my dreams to finally come true, isn’t it?
: Why is this your dream, Futaba?
scene futabaliblove37
: Huh?
: How does hearing me say I love you get you any closer to a future outside of...Business Inc. or whatever?
: CompanyCorp. BUSINESS is just what they do.
: Right. Well, how does any of this keep you away from that?
: It doesn’t. In fact, you don’t really play any role in my future at all. That’s in my hands. It’s for me to decide.
: But all this time, I’ve been content with just coasting by as both a person and a love interest. And that might be fine in high school, but once I’m out of here? I won’t be prepared for anything.
: I’ll have made it all the way to adulthood without ever even settling into who I was as a kid. And I don’t want to be someone people look back on and worry about. Or worse — forget.
: So when I say that this is my dream come true, I’m not just talking about you. Because in this moment, I’m the closest I’ve ever come to actually loving myself.
: I know you wanted something more definitive than just that. And I’m sorry I can’t give it to you. I’m sorry I might never be able to.
: But it’s fine if we just do our best, isn’t it?
: Are you doing your best, Sensei?
: And if you’re not, is there anything I can do to help?
: Futaba...you know you’re too good for me, right?
scene futabaliblove38
: Even zero is greater than negative one.
: So what time should I be at your dorm?
: Seven sharp. That should give us at least two hours before Rin gets home.
: Got it. I love you.
: I love you too.
scene black
: I can’t wait to show you just how much later...
She does just that, but I wish her words were different.
I yearn to learn new ways to love.
I need to do my best.
